dedupe_keys.name: potentials of domestic biomass resources for the energy transition in switzerland wsl national cantonal and municipal

description: This WSL dataset estimates domestic biomass resources and their energy potentials for Switzerland, produced within the Swiss Competence Centers for Energy Research and the Biosweet biomass centre to support the Energy Strategy 2050. Using one consistent approach, it covers ten woody and non-woody biomass categories, giving quantities in cubic metres and fresh and dry weight and energy potentials in petajoules of primary energy and biomethane. It first estimates the theoretical potential that could be collected each year, then subtracts restrictions for competing material uses, environmental factors and supply costs to reach the sustainable potential, and finally the additional sustainable potential beyond current bioenergy production. EnviDat offers spreadsheets at national, cantonal and municipal level, monthly theoretical and sustainable potentials for 2014, agricultural potential for 2018 on 2022 municipalities with monthly split, and a note on biomass supply costs, all available for free download; the full report is in the WSL repository. The dataset was published in 2017 under the WSL Data Policy. Coverage is Switzerland. Caveats: most figures reflect 2014 data, and the WSL Data Policy, not an open licence governs reuse. Simulation uses are biomass and biomethane supply potentials by municipality for heat, gas and power system scenarios. Related records: data-ch-rpv300-rooftop-pv-profiles-switzerland gives the solar counterpart.
